$comment: Compatibility sweep round 12 list (compiled by Android compat round 15; no desktop sweep ran for these ranks, the desktop sweep having moved to a per-release cadence after its round 7): the next 30 Chrome Web Store extensions by install count after the top 30 of round 1, the 30 of next30.json and the 30 of each of next30-round3.json to next30-round11.json (ranks 331-360; manifests under the project store internal/extensions/next30-round12/). Counts are the store detail pages' rounded figures read 2026-09-24; ties inside one rounded bucket are ordered by the page's rating count, equal rounded rating counts by name. Candidates came from the store's category listings and keyword searches, about 17,600 detail pages probed across rounds 3 to 12 (this round added 299 search terms and 1,540 new detail pages; four of them read the rounded 500,000 bucket or above - MEGA at 1,000,000 users, Sicoob | Internet banking and cat-catch at 800,000, Tabby Cat at 500,000 - counts that would have placed the first three in the earlier lists had the store's listings or the earlier rounds' terms surfaced them, so they are ranks 331 to 333 as the highest-count items not yet listed, the earlier lists standing as compiled; the other 1,536 are all below the rounded 500,000 bucket). Every unlisted candidate at or above the rounded 500,000 bucket (123 detail pages) was read again on 2026-09-24 after round 14's read of the same day, and no count or rating count had moved. Ranks 334-351 are the rounded 600,000 bucket's 18 rankable items left after round 14's seven (its cut fell between Talend API Tester at 4.3K ratings and RoboForm Password Manager at 3.8K, so RoboForm is rank 334) in rating order, and ranks 352-360 the rounded 500,000 bucket's nine items with the most ratings; the cut falls between Karma at 3.9K ratings and Simplify Copilot at 3.8K. Not ranked: themes (Morpheon Dark, Dark Theme for Google Chrome), Chrome Apps (Google Classroom, Postman), organisation-managed or organisation-login-only items (ClassLink OneClick, Clever, Mobility Print, Endpoint Verification, Lightspeed Insight Agent, Okta Browser Plugin, Trellix Endpoint Security Web Control, LearnPlatform for Students, OpenText Content Server Browser Web Extension, My Apps Secure Sign-in Extension, MasteryConnect LockDown Browser, HID Credential Management Extension, Snow Web Application Metering, iboss Cloud Connector, LanSchool Web Helper, Browser Security Plus, Browser Redirection Extension, ActivID CMS extension, Britannica School Insights, Securly for Chromebooks, Idira Identity Browser Extension, Citrix Web Extension) and Google items whose detail pages publish no user count. Sicoob | Internet banking is a bank's companion for its own customers' sign-in and is ranked (a consumer item, as True Key and Google Voice were), its core check stopping at the account.
